title: [IMP2-7] `agora_admission_host` is in `required_capabilities`, but clients only advertise 0xF0A1
description: Review finding IMP2-7: `agora_admission_host` is in `required_capabilities`, but clients only advertise 0xF0A1 (lens IMP2). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:73; spec/04-access-control.md:158; spec/05-messaging.md:122-127. Fix: RFC 9420 requires every leaf to support each extension listed in `required_capabilities`. Change 05:73 to "lists 0xF0A0 and 0xF0A1 in its leaf `capabilities.extensions`", and add the check to the KeyPackage validation list in §5.2.1.1. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
